title: Astral Abdication
description: Just another silly building block mod
body:
A building block mod that adds a variety of blocks, including:

### Astralite
A whole new metal block set with bricks included. Doesn't have tools or anything special at the moment.

### Voidslate
A set of bricks and tiles crafted from deepslate and dyes.

### Cosmic wood
An entire tree and woodset, currently missing a sign and boats.

### Violent marble
A set of blocks based on violence ultrakill.

### Fraudulant shopping tiles
A set of blocks based on fraud's shopping

### Fraudulant wallpaper
A set of blocks based on frauds wallpapers

### Renaissance forcefields
A glass like block based on ultrakills lust layer.

### Wacky glass
A glass texture my artist made

And finally, this mod adds a renderer for my god character Asferia, thank you agmas :D
